title: Can GPT-4 Identify Propaganda? Annotation and Detection of Propaganda Spans in News Articles
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection of propaganda techniques in Arabic news articles. While the dataset contains articles categorized under 'Religion' and identifies 'Appeal to Values' (which may include religious values) as a propaganda technique, the study is centered on linguistic classification and span detection rather than benchmarking religious knowledge, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks.
